name: Timber
description: Standard timber sections (4x2, 3x2, 2x2, CLS, joists, posts, battens) at any length, placed on the origin or parallel or at 90 degrees to a selected timber.

size.title: Size
size.description: Actual section in mm, thickness x width.

oneOf.title: 4x2 sawn (47 x 100)
oneOf.description: Regularised C16/C24, the common framing size.

oneOf.title: 4x2 CLS (38 x 89)
oneOf.description: Planed, rounded edges: stud walls.

oneOf.title: 3x2 CLS (38 x 63)
oneOf.description: Planed, rounded edges: light stud walls.

oneOf.title: 2x2 planed (44 x 44)
oneOf.description: Planed all round.

oneOf.title: Batten (25 x 50)
oneOf.description: Roof and cladding batten.

oneOf.title: Custom
oneOf.description: Thickness and width from the two Custom fields.

inches.title: Inches
inches.description: Plain numbers below are inches instead of mm, and the run's parameters are in inches. A value with its own unit is converted: 2400 mm, 2.4 m, 8', 96", 8' 6", 1 1/2".

length.title: Length
length.description: A plain number is mm, or inches with Inches ticked. A value with its own unit is converted: 2400 mm, 2.4 m, 8', 96", 8' 6", 1 1/2". 0 or empty: as long as the selected timber.

place.title: Place
place.description: Parallel and At 90 degrees go against the timber you selected: click it before opening this.

oneOf.title: At the origin
oneOf.description: Its corner on 0, 0, 0, running along Direction.

oneOf.title: Parallel to selected
oneOf.description: Runs the same way as the selected timber.

oneOf.title: At 90 degrees to selected
oneOf.description: Runs square to the selected timber.

oneOf.title: Side
oneOf.description: Parallel: beside it, Spacing apart (a joist or stud run). 90 degrees: against its side, like a rail on a post.

oneOf.title: Other side
oneOf.description: The same, on the opposite side.

oneOf.title: On top
oneOf.description: Parallel: stacked on it. 90 degrees: crossing over it, like joists on a bearer.

oneOf.title: Underneath
oneOf.description: Parallel: under it. 90 degrees: crossing under it.

oneOf.title: Far end
oneOf.description: Parallel: in line, butted on its end. 90 degrees: across its end, like a rim joist.

oneOf.title: Near end
oneOf.description: The same at its other end.

along.title: Along it from
along.description: 90 degrees on top, underneath or on a side: where the first one goes along the selected timber.

oneOf.title: Start
oneOf.description: Flush with its start (lowest X, Y or Z).

oneOf.title: Middle
oneOf.description: Centred; several are spread evenly about the middle.

oneOf.title: End
oneOf.description: Flush with its end, the next ones working back.

count.title: How many
count.description: Several make a run, Spacing apart.

spacing.title: Spacing
spacing.description: Centre to centre, such as 400 mm, 600 mm or 16". 0: touching.

direction.title: Direction
direction.description: Which way the length runs. Auto: X at the origin, square to the selected timber at 90 degrees. Parallel always follows the selected timber.

oneOf.title: Auto
oneOf.description: As the selected timber when parallel, else on edge.

oneOf.title: On edge
oneOf.description: Wide face vertical, like a joist. Upright: wide face along Y.

oneOf.title: Flat
oneOf.description: Wide face down, like a batten. Upright: wide face along X.

custom_thickness.title: Custom thickness
custom_thickness.description: Only for Size Custom. mm, or inches with Inches ticked; or with a unit, such as 1 1/2".

custom_width.title: Custom width
custom_width.description: Only for Size Custom. mm, or inches with Inches ticked; or with a unit, such as 3 1/2".

name.title: Name
name.description: Empty: the size, such as 4x2. A name that is taken gets the next free number; several are numbered #1, #2.
